page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: a page number at the top left, the running head at the top right, and one column of text. Right page: only its left edge is visible, with a running head and fragments of a column cut off by the scan edge.

main_text.p: „ridem, alij Scyronem, nonnulli Pha-larim, multi Tryphonem, vel Gygem ap-pellarint.] Neque enim, inquit, ipse Capitolinus, homo Ethnicus, erat crude-lius animal in terris omnia sic in viribus[?] suis ponens, quasi non posset occi[?]: In-super tam vorax carnis, ut 4o.libras[?] sin-gulis diebus comederet, nec tamen car-nis voracior quâ sitiens fuit humani san-guinis, & si erga suos, milites, Senatores, aliosque suæ ipsius superstitionis culto-res adeo immane se & ferû præbuerit, qualem quasi in Christianos, quos publicos hostes reputabat se gessisse credibile est? Cùm interim tamen plu-rimi Christiani, non modo in Exercitu, sed in ipsa Aula Cæsaris : imò ex stirpe Cæsarea versarentur, ut patet ex Eusebio cuius hæc sunt verba, lib.6.cap.21. [A-lexandro Romano Imperatore, Maxi-minus Cæsar successit, qui propter gra-vem invidiam, qua contra Alexandri familiam in qua complures fideles & Christiani versabantur, flagrabat, a-cerbam persecutionis tempestatem concitauit,] neque Christianorum tamen quenquam legimus, vel cum Pu-
[Right page, cut off at the scan edge; visible fragments only: pien / Bal / fac / bus / lum / ni / hu / Qu / ipf / & / qu / au / im / er / P / bi / el / lu / C / ft / ci / ri / N / i / p / t / e]

page.notes: The page number "92" and the running head are printed in a decorative style, read here as printed. Two words in the column are hidden by a dark blotch from the scan: "viribus" (the "ri" is covered) and "occi[?]" (the final letter is covered). Also "libras" is partly obscured. The right printed page is cut off by the scan edge, so its lines are only partly visible and are transcribed as fragments. The long s in the text is printed as f-like forms (e.g. "geffiffe") and is transcribed as plain s.
